fields.note: A high shear modulus leaves the crimp branch. Gamma then becomes the knockdown 0.20, and global buckling is scored with that factor. For Be S-200F the best aluminium row is CR-III 5056 at 1.6 pcf, least SF 0.668649769509 by global buckling, below the HRH-10 crimp balance 0.685338231171. The 1/4 and 3/8 cells tie. Plascore 3/16-2.0, W shear 20 ksi and transferred Ec 34 ksi, reaches 0.641722323466 by the same mode. The higher W shear does not raise the leading safety factors. 6061-T6 does move, to 0.145930331406 on CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0.
